## Author checklist
- [ ] I only changed files I own (or tagged the owner)
- [ ] Code, comments, commit messages and this description are in English
- [ ] Tests added or updated, CI is green
- [ ] No secrets, large files, absolute paths or debug prints
- [ ] Config and seed are committed; the test split is not used
- [ ] Documentation, `runs/results.md` or the report section updated if needed

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The change matches the description and the linked issue
- [ ] Correctness and edge cases reviewed; tests are meaningful
- [ ] Readability: names, structure, comments, no dead code
- [ ] Reproducibility: seed, config, run id, metrics compared with the baseline
- [ ] Report/slides: numbers match `runs/results.md`, figures readable, citations present
- [ ] I can explain this change in my own words
